rule: # HOW OBTAINED: php-parser over src/ plus ChannelDeclarationReader through reflection, 2026-08-22.
# BOUNDARY OF THE SET — read this before trusting a count taken from this file.
# The producer set is the 42 rules the container registers (`bin/qmx rules`
# reports "42 rules available"). This table holds 42 rows. An earlier revision
# held 41: the missing producer was `computed.health` / ComputedMetricRule,
# because the extraction walked `*Rule.php` files under the rule-owning
# capability roots and that rule declares its NAME through
# omission mattered: `computed.health` is the single producer the whole level
# argument of R1 rests on, so the enumeration was missing its own witness.
#  - `channels` for computed.health is open-ended by construction: six built-in
#    health dimensions plus any `computed.*` a user declares in qmx.yaml. No
#    fixed table can enumerate the second half.
#  - `option_classes` is NOISE for hierarchical rules: the column lists every
#    options class reachable from the rule file, not the ones it owns. Ten
#    entries against complexity.cyclomatic is an artefact of that, not a fact
#    about the rule. Use enumeration-channel-levels.tsv for level facts.
#  - `literal_level_suffixes` counts single-quoted occurrences only; a suffix
#    composed at run time is invisible to it.
